summary: Dylan Redwine, 13, of Colorado Springs, disappeared during a court-ordered Thanksgiving visit with his father at the father's home near Vallecito Lake; mother Elaine Redwine reported him missing to the La Plata County Sheriff's Office on Nov 19. Massive multi-agency search of the Vallecito/Middle Mountain area (~45 personnel, 1,600+ man-hours over a 5-day June-2013 Middle Mountain Road search, 8,000-11,000 ft) incl. La Plata County SAR, AZSTAR K-9 teams, NecroSearch, and divers in Vallecito Lake; remains identified June 2013; father convicted of second-degree murder + child abuse in 2021 (48-year sentence).
location: Vallecito Lake / Middle Mountain Road, north of Vallecito Lake
responding_agency: La Plata County Sheriff's Office / La Plata County SAR
notes: SNIPPET-SOURCED: Telegraph Nov-29-2012 Quick-and-Dirty item via search index (archives.durangotelegraph.com ColdFusion-errors on direct open, 7th failed check run 866); incident date pinned Mon 2012-11-19 by Telegraph text + KSUT corroboration (parent-opened); homicide-resolution details corroborated from multiple sources by the mining worker.
